# ractermx_domain_dns_records (Data Source)

Reads the required DNS records for a RacterMX domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the required DNS records for a domain.
# Use these values to configure DNS at your DNS provider.
data "ractermx_domain_dns_records" "example" {
  domain_id = ractermx_domain.example.id
}

output "mx_record_value" {
  value = data.ractermx_domain_dns_records.example.mx.value
}

output "spf_record_value" {
  value = data.ractermx_domain_dns_records.example.spf.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain.

### Read-Only

- `dkim` (Attributes) The DKIM DNS record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim))
- `dmarc` (Attributes) The DMARC DNS record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dmarc))
- `mx` (Attributes) The MX DNS record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mx))
- `spf` (Attributes) The SPF DNS record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spf))
